text:
Maya (People Ops): Hey y'all — quick heads up: Mike's birthday is Wed 6/12. Thinking low-key surprise breakfast in the kitchen at 9:15am. Who's in? Reply with an emoji and any dietary flags. :croissant:

Alex: In! I'll grab coffee. Decaf ok? :coffee:

Priya: I'll bring donuts (one gluten-free box). No nuts please 36c

Ben: Count me in. Want to do a group card or a plant? :seedling:

Ivy: Plant! low-maintenance. I'll pick something from the nursery.

Sam: I'll Venmo for a gift card. Who's collecting?

Maya (People Ops): Great volunteers. Quick poll: card + plant, or card + gift card? React with :seedling: for plant, :gift: for gift card.

Alex: :seedling: (plant)

Priya: :gift: (I'd prefer gift card so remote can contribute easily)

Ben: :seedling:

Ivy: :seedling: + I can write a joke in the card :laughing:

Sam: :gift: I'll Venmo @Maya-Redwood with reference "Mike bday".

ConfettiBot: Reminder set: 6/12 8:30am assign pickup tasks.

Maya (People Ops): Noted on Venmo. I'll track contributions in this thread and send a reminder tomorrow. Food plan: Alex (coffee), Priya (donuts GF/regular), Ben (napkins/plates), Maya (card + table setup).

Alex: Also can someone bring a small speaker? Background tunes are a must :notes:

Priya: FYI Mike dislikes surprises. Should we check? I can subtly ask if "casual breakfast" works without saying birthday.

Ben: Oh good catch. I saw him mention "no surprises" at lunch last week. Maybe not a full-blown surprise. Keep it casual: say "Team breakfast to celebrate" and don't shout "surprise"?

Maya (People Ops): Ok pivot: we'll call it a "casual team breakfast for Mike" on the calendar at 9:15, no surprise shouting. Still do card/plant/gift card. Everyone okay?

Ivy: Sounds good. Low-key works for me.

Sam: Fine by me. I'll still Venmo.

Maya (People Ops): Awesome. Final checklist: 1) Alex - coffee, 2) Priya - donuts (GF labeled), 3) Ben - napkins/plates, 4) Ivy - plant + card message, 5) Sam - gift card funds to Maya. I'll create a short sign-up note on the event and add a Zoom link for remote folks to pop in for a minute.

Priya: Can we put allergy labels on the food? I'll print tiny signs.

Maya (People Ops): Yes please. Also I'll ask Facilities for a small vase for the plant.

Ben: I'll bring adhesive name tags so remote folks can write a quick note to stick on the card via printout.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 49a Closing thread but will ping with final reminder tomorrow morning. See you 6/12 at 9:15 (kitchen).
